The '''Lady Yarith''' was a squalid [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] owned by [[Bozzi]] in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was named after [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg's]] wife. [[Elaiza]] occupied a room there during the auction of the [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]].
